intent: Serialize MCP calls that depend on the singleton current diagram in invocation order, preserve safe overlapping exports behind a snapshot-read barrier, and keep the queue live after a rejected request.
applied_fixes: Added explicit filename narrowing in the e2e test instead of relying on non-null assertions.
Added a delayed export-followed-by-close interleaving to verify the snapshot-read barrier.
residual_risks: FIFO ordering does not add request admission control; a client can still accumulate pending work by flooding the stdio server.
agent_native: Pass: the change strengthens the ordering semantics of the existing MCP tool interface without creating a human-only capability.
learnings: No docs/solutions directory exists in this repository, so no prior solution matched this change.
